name: Cloak of Arachnida
description: A black silk cloak with a spider of silver thread across its shoulders.
body:
## What it does

Venom bites you less, webs never catch you, and you climb as fast as you walk, along walls and upside down across ceilings, with your hands free.

## Web

Once a day you can cast web from it, filling twice the space the spell usually does.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.text: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed and can move on walls and ceilings with your hands free.

features.name: Webwalker
features.text: Webs never catch you, and you move through them as through difficult terrain.
